signature.name: VTask.restrictDegree
signature.type: (σ : Type u) -> (R : Type v) -> [CommSemiring R] -> (m : ℕ) -> Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

conventions.statement: When m = 0, the submodule VTask.restrictDegree σ R 0 consists exactly of the constant polynomials, i.e., those whose only potentially nonzero monomial is the zero exponent vector.
conventions.note: The bound is inclusive (≤), so exponent 0 = m = 0 is allowed, but any positive exponent is excluded.

conventions.statement: The degree bound m is inclusive: a monomial whose exponent for variable i equals exactly m is permitted in the submodule.
conventions.note: The membership condition is n i ≤ m, not n i < m.

facts.statement: ∀ (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (m₁ m₂ : ℕ), m₁ ≤ m₂ → VTask.restrictDegree σ R m₁ ≤ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m₂

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (m : ℕ) (p q : MvPolynomial σ R), p ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m → q ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m → p + q ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (m : ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), p ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m → r • p ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R m

facts.statement: ∀ (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (r : R), MvPolynomial.C r ∈ VTask.restrictDegree σ R 0

facts.statement: ∀ (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ), MvPolynomial.X i ∉ VTask.restrictDegree σ R 0
